title: Main Axis Alignment 📏
description: Distribute items along the main axis using `justify-content`.

slides.title: `justify-content`: Spacing Along the Main Axis 🧮
slides.content:
# Control Horizontal (or Vertical) Alignment

`justify-content` defines how extra space is distributed between and around flex items along the main axis. Common values:
- `flex-start` (default) – items packed at the start.
- `flex-end` – items packed at the end.
- `center` – items centred.
- `space-between` – first item at start, last at end, equal gaps between.
- `space-around` – equal space around each item (half‑sized at ends).
- `space-evenly` – equal space between items and edges.

slides.title: Justify Content Examples

quizData.question: Which value of `justify-content` puts equal space between items but half‑space at the ends?
quizData.explanation: `space-around` distributes space around each item, so edges get half the gap size.

slides.title: Safe & Unsafe Alignment (Overflow) ⚠️
slides.content:
# When Items Overflow

You can prepend `safe` or `unsafe` to alignment keywords (e.g., `justify-content: safe center;`).
- `safe` – if items overflow, alignment falls back to `start`.
- `unsafe` – alignment stays even if items overflow (data loss).

Browser support is still limited, but it's good to know.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## `space-between` for Navigation

A common pattern: Logo on left, nav links on right. Wrap them in a flex container with `justify-content: space-between;`. If you need exact spacing, use `gap`.
